name: command-palette
description: A searchable command list (⌘K) that lives inside an overlay host: place it as the child of an overlay.modal or overlay.drawer, which opens it and which it closes when a command runs.

knowledge.purpose: Searchable command/action palette (⌘K) that filters a list of items by label, placed inside an overlay.modal or overlay.drawer that opens and closes it
useCases: Jump-to navigation across pages or records
antiPatterns: Placed bare on a page, outside an overlay.modal or overlay.drawer — it has no open/close of its own: its list stays open, and running a command dismisses a host that is not there
Primary page navigation — compose it from primitives
Static list of links — use data.list
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ id?: string; label: string; hint?: string; icon?: string; href?: string }>

jsonSchema.description: The commands. Empty by default: list the app's own actions. Running one emits block:click {action:"run", id, value, href} and follows href in a live render.
Shortcut shown in the search row. When set, Ctrl+K / ⌘K focuses the search.
Shown when the search matches nothing. Nothing is shown when omitted.
